raw.details:
Overview

Five editions. Pass the baton, build the future.

WebnD, the Web and Design Society of IIT Bhubaneswar, is back with the fifth edition of its flagship hackathon. Builders, dreamers and problem-solvers from across India will battle it out in two electrifying tracks: Web2 and Web3. 

PPI Opportunities

Top performers in the Web2 tracks get a shot at Pre-Placement Interview (PPI) opportunities from CSM Technologies. Build something great and it could land you more than a trophy.

Who Can Join the Relay

  • Open to everyone, whatever your discipline, degree or background
  • Squad up in teams of 2 to 4 members
  • Teammates can come from different colleges, schools or organisations
  • Teams lock the moment you register, with no swaps and no substitutions. Pick your dream team wisely.

Round 1: The Ideathon and Prototyping (Online)

  • Problem statements for both tracks drop for all registered teams.
  • Pitch your best idea in one PPT using the provided template by December 12.
  • Want to stand out? Attach a working prototype and score bonus points.
  • The most promising teams will be shortlisted and invited to the main arena.

Round 2: The Hackathon (On-site at IIT Bhubaneswar)

  • Shortlisted teams must report on campus by January 15. Miss the check-in and you are out of the race.
  • Get 30 hours of non-stop building, with power and internet on us throughout.
  • Take the stage and pitch live to the judges: your idea, your product and your business strategy.
  • Fair play matters. Pre-existing projects are allowed only if disclosed in advance, and undisclosed ones will be disqualified.

The Finale

Celebrate the final lap at a networking lunch with fellow participants, judges, sponsors and speakers. Great code gets you here, great connections take you further.

Mark Your Calendar

  • December 12: Round 1 PPT submission deadline
  • January 15: Reporting day for shortlisted teams at IIT Bhubaneswar

Why You Should Run This Relay

  • Tackle real-world problem statements across Web2 and Web3
  • Go from raw idea to working product in just 30 intense hours
  • Learn to sell your vision, not just your code
  • Meet the judges, sponsors and speakers who can shape your journey

Join the Community

Don’t just run the relay, be part of the buzz! Get live updates, find teammates, ask your questions and connect with organisers and fellow participants.

  • Join our Discord server for announcements, updates and instant answers to your queries: Join the Discord
  • Follow Code Relay on Instagram for event updates, sneak peeks and announcements: Follow CodeRelay on Instagram!!
  • Follow WebnD on Instagram to see what the society is building beyond the relay: Follow WebnD on Instagram!!
  • Become a Campus Ambassador and take the relay to your college. Rally teams, lead the buzz and earn certificates, goodies and recognition: Campus Ambassador Form

Your team. Your track. Your baton. Register now and let the relay begin!
